Overall, the Intelligent Research Assistant achieves the objectives defined at the be-
ginning of the project. It provides an effective solution for intelligent document analysis,
semantic information retrieval, and AI-assisted research. The project also establishes a
strong foundation for future enhancements such as multilingual support, cloud deploy-
ment, OCR integration, collaborative research environments, and advanced AI capabili-
ties.
The successful completion of this project demonstrates the practical application of
Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval, and Large Language
Models in solving real-world research challenges. The developed system has significant
potential for use in academic institutions, research laboratories, libraries, and industrial
organizations where efficient knowledge discovery from large document collections is es-
sential.
